text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer over there!!
Please, take a flyer!

The flyer Smart Falcon suddenly handed me
read, "100-Idol Battle☆
Idol Fest."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Falco is going to perform representing all Umadols!
If you'd like... no, you definitely have to come cheer for me!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna do tons and tons of "special training"
and show everyone the sheer brilliance of Umadols pe~rfectly...!

Recalling her extraordinary enthusiasm,
I headed over to the racecourse, and—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Order from Falcon-san,
"Escape from the front"... Shall we complete it?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I don't see why we shouldn't continue.
I still want to run more, too...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait...! Wa-ait...!
Aaaaaah~!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not it! Falco just wanted
to dance an escape-running dance with you two...!
At least do it on dirt! Let me catch up~!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Or wait, is this training kind of weird if I think about it?
Should I be doing my best in a more Umadol-like way?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
Great timing!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You see, I need some advice!
What do you think is the best thing about an Umadol?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Is it being super cute after all?
Or is it a powerful performance?!
choice_data_list: Well, what is an Umadol in the first place—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, look at Falco!
Whatever your intuition says is the answer!
choice_data_list: When it comes to Umadols, it's cuteness!
When it comes to Umadols, it's power!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Right?!!
Let's get some cuteness training!

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text:
—Okay, then just copy Karen.
Ready, and...

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text: Aha♪

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text: Yaa~n☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...How was that?
Do you think Falco will shine the brightest
out of all 100 idols?!

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text:
Of course♪ But if you're feeling unsure,
there's also the "Super Cute Falco-chan Course"...

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's thoughts, emotions, past, and future...
I can teach you how to dye it aaall in Falco-san's colors...♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
*G-Gulp*...
Make everything about everyone into Falco...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...N-No, that feels a bit off, maybe?!

After watching over Smart Falcon,
I returned from an outing late that night, and...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! That power unique to horse girls
is definitely part of the charm!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to power...
I should ask that person!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
—Nice! Your muscles are loving it!
Just 10 more deadlifts, let's push past the limit!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Nngh... Nunununu☆
Uyaaaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ohh...!
Ohooooooooohhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You really are incredible!
Top-tier muscles! Nice bulk!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ryan-san...!
Then, can Falco—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You can make it straight to the top...!
Go grab 1st place at the bodybuilding competition!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm not entering that, okay?! But during the live show,
I'll show everyone my razor-sharp moves!

After watching over Smart Falcon,
I returned from an outing late that night, and...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
*Haa... haa...*
Umadol... fight... oh~...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! We sure run into each other a lot today, huh?
Thanks for keeping me company during training!
choice_data_list: ...Were you still working hard this whole time?
...Were you still working hard this whole time?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I mean, 100 idols are gonna perform, you know?
Isn't this a huge chance
to let the fans learn all about Umadols?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Falco is suuuper cute, and powerful,
and the best!
...Or so I'd like to say, but I'm still growing.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I'm representing all Umadols out there!
I have to deliver the absolute best performance.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Just like how I was shown a wonderful dream...
Giving everyone hope is what an Umadol is all about!
choice_data_list: You really love Umadols, don't you?
You really love Umadols, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yes, exactly!
Falco... absolutely loves Umadols.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I think... I get it now. What's most important is...
Ehehe, thank you for giving me such a great hint!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
As thanks, maybe I'll get you a guest pass
for the event☆ You definitely have to come watch, okay!
